Bill.BriefDescription: Planning for future impacts at Saint Edward state park.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring the state parks and recreationcommission to fully plan for potential future impacts at Saint Edwardstate park; creating new sections; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds Bastyr University, anonprofit, private university, is located adjacent to Saint Edwardstate park. The legislature also recognizes the fact that BastyrUniversity has recently adopted a twentyfiveyear campus master planthat outlines significant growth for the university over the next fewdecades. Growth of both the university's enrollment and physical sizewill have an impact on the neighboring Saint Edward state park. Thelegislature finds that the state parks and recreation commission shouldwork with Bastyr University and complete necessary planning to addressthe potential future impact on Saint Edward state park that may arisefrom the planned expansion of Bastyr University.

(1) The state parks and recreationcommission shall initiate and complete an in-depth review and fullplanning process to address the immediate and long-term potential p. 1 HB 1712future impacts to Saint Edward state park arising from the plannedexpansion of Bastyr University. The planning process must, at aminimum, consider the impacts on: (a) Traffic in and around the park, including all access roads; (b) Emergency vehicle access; (c) Parking in the park; (d) The adequacy of the park's utilities; (e) The impacts of increased use of the facilities, including theswimming pool, the gymnasium, the sports field, the great lawn, andhiking and biking trails; and (f) The impacts of increased use on the flora and fauna of thepark. (2) The review conducted under this section must also consider theutility of and barriers to a cost-sharing agreement between the stateparks and recreation commission and Bastyr University to financiallyaid the park in the execution of the plan developed under this section. (3) The documents required by this section must be completed andreported to the appropriate committees of the legislature by January 1,2008. Prior to the final adoption of the required documents, the stateparks and recreation commission shall conduct at least one publichearing on the draft documents in a community near Saint Edward statepark.
